newsitem.title: THAILAND: TABLE-Thai July CPI up 4.9 pct yr/yr - ministry.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Thai July CPI up 4.9 pct yr/yr - ministry.

text.p: The Thai consumer price index (CPI) rose 4.9 percent year-on-year in July against a 4.4 percent rise in June, the Commerce Ministry said on Friday.
The ministry said the 1990-based index rose to 140.0 in July from its 133.5 level in the same month a year ago.
The Thai Commerce Ministry issued the following economic indicators:
THAI CONSUMER PRICE July 97 June 97 July 96
NOTES: In the food and beverage category, prices of flour and flour products rose 4.7 percent July from June. Prices of vegetables and fruits increased 4.4 percent month on month.
In the non-food group price of garments, housing costs, medical expenses, entertainment, education, tobacco and alcoholic drinks all increased 0.1 percent from the previous month.
